EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST

CLINICAL HISTORY:
Follow-up of multiple pulmonary nodules.

COMPARISON:
None available.

FINDINGS:

LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
There is an 8 mm subpleural solid nodule in the posterior basal left lower lobe. Separate 4 mm solid nodule in the superior segment of the left lower lobe. No additional suspicious pulmonary nodule.

MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:
Left hilar lymph node measures 8 mm in short axis.

IMPRESSION:

1. Two separate left lower lobe pulmonary nodules measuring 8 mm and 4 mm.
2. Mildly prominent 8 mm left hilar lymph node.

EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST

CLINICAL HISTORY:
Pulmonary nodule surveillance.

COMPARISON:
CT chest 03/03/2024.

FINDINGS:

LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
Posterior left lung base subpleural nodule measures 8 mm and is unchanged. New 5 mm solid nodule in the right middle lobe. No other new suspicious pulmonary nodule.

MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:
No hilar or mediastinal lymphadenopathy.

IMPRESSION:

1. Stable 8 mm posterior left lung base nodule.
2. New 5 mm right middle lobe pulmonary nodule.

EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST

CLINICAL HISTORY:
Follow-up pulmonary nodules.

COMPARISON:
CT chest 09/09/2024.

FINDINGS:

LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
Subpleural nodule in the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe measures 9 mm, previously 8 mm. A 4 mm medial left lower lobe nodule is unchanged. Previously seen right middle lobe 5 mm nodule is no longer identified. No new suspicious pulmonary nodule.

MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:
Left hilar lymph node measures 10 mm in short axis.

IMPRESSION:

1. Slight increase in size of the posterior basal left lower lobe nodule, now 9 mm.
2. Stable separate 4 mm left lower lobe nodule.
3. Resolution of the right middle lobe nodule, likely inflammatory.
4. Mildly enlarged 10 mm left hilar lymph node.

EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST

CLINICAL HISTORY:
Continued nodule surveillance.

COMPARISON:
CT chest 03/18/2025.

FINDINGS:

LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
Posterior left lower lobe subpleural nodule measures 9 mm and is unchanged. New 6 mm ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe. No additional new suspicious pulmonary nodule.

MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:
Mild left hilar adenopathy is unchanged.

IMPRESSION:

1. Stable 9 mm posterior left lower lobe subpleural nodule.
2. New 6 mm left upper lobe ground-glass nodule. Recommend follow-up to ensure resolution.
3. Stable mild left hilar adenopathy.

EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST

CLINICAL HISTORY:
Follow-up of pulmonary nodules.

COMPARISON:
CT chest 10/04/2025.

FINDINGS:

LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
Posterior basal left lower lobe solid nodule measures 9 mm, unchanged. Separate 4 mm left lower lobe nodule is unchanged from more remote examinations. The previously noted left upper lobe ground-glass nodule has resolved. No new suspicious pulmonary nodule.

MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:
Left hilar node measures 10 mm in short axis, unchanged.

IMPRESSION:

1. Stable 9 mm and 4 mm left lower lobe nodules.
2. Resolved left upper lobe ground-glass nodule.
3. Stable 10 mm left hilar lymph node.
